I need to consider the historical facts about the 1944 "Bomb Plot."

The failed "Bomb Plot" of 1944 refers to Operation Valkyrie (Unternehmen Walküre), which took place on July 20, 1944. This was an assassination attempt carried out by German military officers, most notably Colonel Claus von Stauffenberg, who placed a briefcase bomb in Hitler's military headquarters, the Wolf's Lair (Wolfsschanze) in East Prussia.

The target was definitively Adolf Hitler. The bomb exploded during a conference, but Hitler survived with relatively minor injuries because the briefcase had been moved behind a thick table leg, which shielded him from the full force of the blast.
